rule.body: For "opposite in meaning", first decide what the underlined word means in the sentence. Then look for the option that means the reverse. Be careful: examiners often include a synonym of the word as a trap, so cross it out first.
rule.example: "Water is [[scarce]] in the dry season": scarce means in short supply, so the opposite is "plentiful".

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: Only [[affluent]] families in the estate can afford three cars.
questions.explanation: "Affluent" means rich, so the opposite is "poor". "Wealthy" is a synonym, not an opposite.

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: The crowd grew [[hostile]] when the referee cancelled the goal.
questions.explanation: "Hostile" means unfriendly and aggressive, so the opposite is "friendly".

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: Water is [[scarce]] in the village during the dry season.
questions.explanation: "Scarce" means in short supply, so the opposite is "plentiful". "Rare" is close to a synonym.

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: Emeka is a [[diligent]] student who never misses an assignment.
questions.explanation: "Diligent" means hardworking and careful, so the opposite is "lazy".

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: Her explanation was so [[lucid]] that everyone understood the topic at once.
questions.explanation: "Lucid" means clear and easy to understand, so the opposite is "confusing".

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: It was [[prudent]] of Tolu to save part of her salary every month.
questions.explanation: "Prudent" means sensible and careful about the future, so the opposite is "reckless".

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: Fame can be [[transient]]; many stars are forgotten within a few years.
questions.explanation: "Transient" means lasting only a short time, so the opposite is "permanent".

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: The speaker was so [[verbose]] that a ten-minute talk took an hour.
questions.explanation: "Verbose" means using too many words, so the opposite is "concise" (brief and to the point).

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: The champion was [[magnanimous]] in victory, praising the team he had just defeated.
questions.explanation: "Magnanimous" means generous and big-hearted towards others, so the opposite is "petty" (small-minded).

questions.stem: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word: The government plans to [[augment]] the number of teachers in rural schools.
questions.explanation: To "augment" means to increase, so the opposite is "reduce".
